_doc: PACT Platform 三阶段统一迁移执行图谱；施工状态唯一真源。
每个 done/pass 必须回写 file:line 与真实命令证据。

nodes.title: PACT Platform 治理与工作区
实现 Core 边界、六类 schema、planned provenance 与迁移冲突门
pitfalls: PACT Core 不得 import 或反向引用 Vima 产品路径
排除集合只能是 C3 的 8 个目录段闭集

nodes.title: 产品快照迁入与 canonical-only 入口
复制闭集快照、写 import manifest 并停在 staged
pitfalls: R013 只验 bootstrap/build 前的 import manifest，不能扫描最终 node_modules/dist/target
staged 时 target 已原子就位但旧绝对路径仍是原目录

evidence: npm test — staged import suite 7/7 pass

nodes.title: 保持 UI npm 包与 Starter CLI/template 身份
建立三个独立 release unit 与根级串行编排
pitfalls: 根编排必须串行，UI 并发 build 会污染 dist 并造成 size 假结果

evidence: npm test — release unit/serial runner suite 2/2 pass

nodes.title: 显式 bootstrap 并通过 UI/Starter 全部门禁
pitfalls: 不得抬高 UI runtime budget；应修复体积根因
Starter bootstrap 只运行受信 lockfile，inspect/plan 不得隐式安装

evidence: npm run verify:products -- --report artifacts/migration/product-verification.v1.json — UI 4/4, Starter 4/4 pass

nodes.title: 过渡期：校验产品报告后备份来源并切换旧路径软链
pitfalls: verification report 必须绑定当前 target hash；缺失或失败不得切链

evidence: npm run migration:verify — linked target/snapshot hash and 2/2 realpath pass

nodes.title: Live 治理数据与能力路由
写入五个 capability、两个 adapter 与兼容矩阵真实 evidence/hash
pitfalls: 同 semver 不同内容必须由 hash+contractVersion+releaseStatus 消歧
Starter 与 Starter adapter 必须保持 partial/blocked，不能虚报 ready

evidence: npm run governance:check — six schemas and evidence pass
npm test — governance valid/invalid/hash fixtures pass

nodes.title: 实现 profile、preferred adapter 集合展开与结构化诊断
pitfalls: Starter 只适用于 business-system 且必须显式 preferred
blocked/partial/incompatible 只返回候选和稳定诊断，不生成

evidence: npm test — Router truth table 4/4 pass
npm run platform:inspect — business-system selects pact-core and lists both adapters

nodes.title: 实现 Git 四集合、归属冲突、依赖传播与稳定 JSON

evidence: npm test — changed paths/propagation/determinism/error fixtures pass
npm run release:plan -- --base HEAD^ --json artifacts/release/plan.v1.json — pass

nodes.title: 本地归档与 PACT 完成门
生成三个本地归档并静态证明无外部发布入口

evidence: npm run release:pack — exactly 3 local archives, published=false
npm test — release safety scan pass

nodes.title: 更新文档、图谱证据并通过原三阶段 pact-review 100%

evidence: npm run verify — all serial gates pass
bash pact/scripts/pact-review.sh .pact/pact-platform-unification — original three phases 100% pass

nodes.title: 验证 canonical target/backup 后退役两个旧入口
pitfalls: 只允许 unlink 两个已验证指向 canonical target 的精确软链接
保留 .pre-pact-20260811 备份；finalized 后不得 rollback 或重建旧入口

evidence: npm test — platform 25/25 pass including finalized schema/hash/recovery
npm run migration:verify — finalized target/snapshot 2/2 hash pass
npm run verify:products -- --report artifacts/migration/product-verification.finalized.v1.json — UI 4/4 and Starter 4/4 pass after alias retirement
test ! -e && test ! -L — both retired aliases absent; both canonical targets and backups preserved
